name: Vision (Aarkus)

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Coldsnap: Ani soğuk hasarı verir ve düşmanın Kaçış yeteneğini kapatır.
abilityDetails.Armor Shattered: Yeni Zırh Kırma etkilerini engeller ve Armor Up etkilerinin yetenek doğruluğunu %200 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): En büyük tehlike onda-i-soğuk hasarı. 3 çözüm: nötralize eden şampiyon (güç kazanımını keser), zırh-kırmaya immün şampiyon, veya onda-i-soğuğa immün şampiyon.
signatureAbility:
Smoke And Mirrors
Whenever Aarkus gains a non-Damaging Debuff, he has a [30 - 100]% chance to Purify one of each non-Damaging Debuff on him. This cannot trigger more than once every 9.5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Aarkus reduces the potency of Power Drain, Steal, and Burn effects by 80%, and the duration of Power Lock effects by 750%.
Aarkus gains 15% less Power from landing and receiving Hits.

abilitySections.title: Power of Smokeworld - Buff - Max: 5
content: Aarkus draws strength from the Smokeworld dimension at all times. He starts the fight with a Power Gain Buff, and gains 1 every 10 second(s).
These Buffs last indefinitely. The first one grants Aarkus 4% of a Bar of Power every 1 second(s), and every subsequent Power Gain Buff is 33.33% less effective.
He also gains one whenever his Power is Drained, Stolen, or Burned, and whenever he receives a Power Lock Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Frozen Air
content: While Aarkus has a Power Gain Buff, he freezes the area near him. Every 2 second(s) the Opponent spends near Aarkus, they gain an Armor Break Debuff, decreasing Armor Rating by [305.56] for 10 second(s). These Armor Breaks are capped at 10.
Armor Break Debuffs on the Opponent are Paused while they are near Aarkus.
While the Opponent is near Aarkus and they have an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff, they also gain a Coldsnap Debuff, dealing [1,097.03] Energy damage every 0.50 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Hits from Special Attacks Pause all Armor Break Debuffs on the Opponent until the end of the Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit refreshes all Armor Break Debuffs on the Opponent. During this Special Attack, all personal effects granted by his Special Attacks 2 and 3 are paused.
If the Opponent is Armor Shattered, this Attack deals [22,937.9] bonus Energy damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Remove all Armor Break Debuffs on the Opponent and replace them with both an Armor Break and Armor Shattered Debuff, that lasts 5 seconds for each one removed.
The Armor Break reduces Armor Rating by [485.29] for each one replaced and removes an Armor Up Buff.
While Armor Shattered, this Champion's #Robot Opponents also suffer from shattered systems, which reduces Combat Power Rate, Ability Power Rate, and Ability Accuracy by -100%.
If the Opponent was already Armor Shattered, instead this Attack deals [17,951.4] bonus Energy damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Aarkus increases the area his abilities affect to cover the entire field for 25 second(s).
If the Opponent is Armor Shattered when this Attack is activated, gain a Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by [17,951.4] for 25 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Smoke And Mirrors
content: Whenever Aarkus gains a non-Damaging Debuff, he has a [30 - 100]% chance to Purify one of each non-Damaging Debuff on him. This cannot trigger more than once every 9.5 second(s).
